messages:
Jon: Roof sprint idea Hey folks, rooftop hill sprint + mobility cooldown at 12:30 today? 4 x 60s hard efforts up the service ramp, then 10 min mobility led by Ada. Fast, dirty, fun. :dash: :sun_with_face:
Priya: Love this. Whats the ramp like? Any slick bits after the rain? :thinking_face:
Liam: I can bring two yoga mats and some minis for ankle drills. Count me in for the cooldown. :muscle:
Jon: Ramp is concrete, short but steep. Not many slippery sections but shoes with decent grip recommended. Well stagger starts 30s apart to avoid pileups.
Ada: Happy to lead mobility! Quick sequence: hip CARs, ankle circles, 90/90s, pigeon-ish stretch. 10 minutes, no mats required if you dont have one. Ill keep it low-impact for folks heading back to meetings. :seedling:
Priya: Can I do the mobility only? Meeting at 1:00.
Liam: Same here, meeting at 12:50, so maybe 2 sprints + mobility for me.
Jon: Totally fine. Its RSVP-lite. Do what you can. :slightly_smiling_face:
Fitness-bot: Event created: "Rooftop hill sprints + mobility" @12:30 (30m). Reminder 10m before.
Priya: Quick gear q  any water on the roof? I might bring a small bottle.
Jon: Bring water. Ill bring a small cooler with 2 bottles and some electrolyte tabs.
Ada: Note for folks with knee issues: go slow on descents, use the handrail if needed. No forced reps.
Liam: Anyone up for a light photo for #random after? Post-run goofy group pic. :camera_with_flash:
Priya: Ill bring a disposable camera joke prop (tiny trophy) for the winner of the fastest sprint. :trophy:
Jon: Winner gets the tiny trophy + a $5 coffee voucher from me. Loser buys the next coffee? :coffee:
Ada: Deal. Also quick reminder to apply sunscreen if youre heading outside. Its brighter than it looks.
Fitness-bot: Weather update: partly cloudy, temps ~18C, no rain expected in next hour.
Liam: Bringing backup mini-band in case we want glute activation before sprints.
Priya: Count: sprints 3 (Jon, Liam, maybe Priya for a couple), mobility-only 2 (Priya, Ada), casual observer 1 (Dev team will probably watch).
Jon: Meetup point: roof access by elevator B, terrace door. Be there 12:25 so we can brief and warm up.
Ada: Warmup plan: 5 mins easy stair walk + dynamic leg swings. Keep it short.
Liam: On my way. See yall in 20.
Jon: Great. Post quick recap here after so folks know how it went. Photo in #random if we get one. Have fun!
